sentences.text: Hello, Peter and Helen! This is my grandpa.

sentences.text: Hello, Mr Fu. Nice to meet you!

sentences.text: Nice to meet you too. Welcome to my house. Let me show you around.

sentences.text: Thank you. Oh, what’s that, Mr Fu? Is that a goose?

sentences.text: Mr Fu, what are those plants? Are they potato plants?

sentences.translation: [需要翻译: No, Peter, they aren’t. They’re carrot plants.]

sentences.text: Look at those rabbits. They’re cute! How many rabbits do you have?
